query: INSERT INTO social_media_streamer_layout (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, layout_json, cam_enabled, mode, updated_at, updated_by) SELECT twitch_login, twitch_user_id, $2::text::jsonb, $3, $4, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $5 FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET streamer_login = EXCLUDED.streamer_login, layout_json = EXCLUDED.layout_json, cam_enabled = EXCLUDED.cam_enabled, mode = EXCLUDED.mode, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
